title: One shared in-process provider stack for test helpers
description: The wiring of a provider stack as main.rs builds it (Store, KeyPackages, Follower, Fanout, Hub, Relay, JMAP router) is written out three times in test helpers: mimid-server tests/common/providers.rs (Provider::boot, with its fault front and outbox capture), mimid-agent tests/common/mod.rs (provider()), mimid-agent-jmap's two_accounts test. mimid-agent cannot include providers.rs (it needs sqlx and the fault front). Decide whether a shared builder belongs somewhere (a dev-only crate, or a mimid-server function main.rs also uses); not done in mimid-4jvf.
